## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.6 adds managed development workflows and Mermaid diagrams in Manager memory previews.

### Development workflows that travel with Threadnote

Threadnote now ships `dev-spec`, `dev-plan`, `dev-cycle` and `watch-pr` as managed workflows for supported Codex and Cursor hosts. Setup can install them by default, and `threadnote dev-skills` can list, preview, install, inspect, update or remove a selected host and scope.

Manager adds a Development workflows page for reviewing destinations, installed generations, readiness and shared consumers before applying a change. Threadnote updates refresh enabled workflow installations while preserving edited, inaccessible or unowned files for review.

### Diagrams in memory previews

Manager renders fenced Mermaid diagrams in memory previews, so architecture and process diagrams can be read alongside the memory that contains them.
